description: Curated map of files an agent is most likely to need when changing Maya.

files.name: CLI entrypoint
files.description: CLI entrypoint delegating into the declarative command registry.
files.whenToUse: Open when adding or tracing a Maya command.

files.name: MCP server
files.description: MCP stdio startup, tool registration, dispatch, safety/audit wrapping, and image responses.
files.whenToUse: Open when changing MCP lifecycle, call semantics, or shared action policy.

files.name: MCP setup
files.description: Registers Maya launch commands through Claude Code and Codex CLIs.
files.whenToUse: Open when debugging or extending coding-agent registration.

files.name: Tool registry
files.description: Defines ToolSpec/MayaTool and merges all standard tool groups.
files.whenToUse: Open when adding a tool or designing shared MCP/CLI execution.

files.name: Browser tools
files.description: Persistent Playwright browser control, form filling, DOM fallback, and page screenshots.
files.whenToUse: Open for browser navigation, interaction, forms, or page screenshot behavior.

files.name: Shell tool
files.description: Bounded one-shot shell command execution.
files.whenToUse: Open for one-shot terminal execution behavior.

files.name: Process tool adapter
files.description: Dependency-gated tools for managed background processes.
files.whenToUse: Open for agent-facing managed process contracts.

files.name: Process manager
files.description: Stateful background process lifecycle and log implementation.
files.whenToUse: Open when changing actual managed process behavior rather than tool metadata.

files.name: File tools
files.description: Text file read, snapshotting write, and trash-based delete operations.
files.whenToUse: Open for current local file action behavior.

files.name: Sensing tools
files.description: Desktop screenshot, clipboard, and active-window context tools.
files.whenToUse: Open for desktop perception rather than browser page perception.

files.name: App tools
files.description: Known native app mapping and xdg-open fallback.
files.whenToUse: Open when adding native app aliases or changing launch behavior.

files.name: Proactive tools
files.description: Desktop notification and reminder tool contracts.
files.whenToUse: Open for agent-facing notification/reminder inputs and outputs.

files.name: Reminder service
files.description: Persisted reminder scheduling, ticking, firing, and cancellation.
files.whenToUse: Open when changing actual reminder behavior or persistence.

files.name: Vault tools
files.description: Obsidian note actions implemented through the ob CLI.
files.whenToUse: Open for Maya's Obsidian adapter.

files.name: Memory tools
files.description: Agent-facing persistent memory save and forget actions.
files.whenToUse: Open for memory tool contracts.

files.name: Memory store
files.description: JSON-backed persistent memory implementation under MAYA_DIR.
files.whenToUse: Open when changing persistence rather than tool presentation.

files.name: Configuration
files.description: Zod schema, runtime paths, defaults, and MAYA_DIR override.
files.whenToUse: Open for runtime configuration, state paths, or doctor checks.

files.name: Audit and undo
files.description: Audit log, reversible file operation records, undo, and retention wiring.
files.whenToUse: Open before exposing side-effecting tool execution through another adapter.

files.name: Catastrophic classifier
files.description: Pure classifier for unrecoverable shell command patterns.
files.whenToUse: Open when preserving shell safety in MCP or future CLI adapters.

files.name: Voice listener
files.description: Current microphone/transcript adapter used by the MCP listen tool.
files.whenToUse: Open when tracing current MCP voice input.

files.name: Text to speech
files.description: Piper synthesis, optional sox effects, paplay output, and null fallback.
files.whenToUse: Open when tracing or testing spoken output.

files.name: Legacy agent loop
files.description: Provider-neutral in-process brain loop used by ask/live/daemon paths.
files.whenToUse: Open when changing existing non-MCP ask/live behavior; do not confuse it with MCP.

files.name: Daemon
files.description: Legacy long-running orchestration for clipboard input, TTS, tools, and overlay.
files.whenToUse: Open when tracing start/stop/status or the legacy always-running path.

files.name: Overlay bridge
files.description: WebSocket state bridge between the live agent path and renderer.
files.whenToUse: Open for current live overlay transport behavior.

files.name: Root package manifest
files.description: Bun package metadata, bin entry, scripts, and dependencies.
files.whenToUse: Open for install, script, dependency, or CLI packaging changes.

files.name: Root TypeScript config
files.description: Strict Bun TypeScript settings for src only.
files.whenToUse: Open when typecheck scope or compiler behavior matters.

files.name: Original README
files.description: Original voice-agent overview, architecture, and development quick start.
files.whenToUse: Use for historical/current product overview; verify details against source.

files.name: Original PRD
files.description: Original voice-assistant product requirements.
files.whenToUse: Use for original product intent, not the CLI-first requirements.

files.name: Capability roadmap
files.description: Current and future capability expansion planning; not all entries are implemented.
files.whenToUse: Use for roadmap context and verify implementation status in source.

files.name: Production roadmap
files.description: Voice rearchitecture and production hardening plan with mixed complete/future work.
files.whenToUse: Use for production/voice planning and verify status in source.

files.name: CLI-first PRD
files.description: Product requirements for the token-efficient CLI, docs, and index system.
files.whenToUse: Use as the product source of truth for future CLI implementation cycles.
